content.text:
Done — `pbt/` now lives at `ts/pbt/`, and everything that referenced the old location is updated and verified.

What moved and what changed:

- **`git mv pbt ts/pbt`** — history preserved as renames.
- **`ts/pbt/serve.mjs`** — the subtle one: it derives its document root from `import.meta.url`, so moving one level deeper required `new URL('..')` → `'../..'`; otherwise it would have served `ts/` as the root and 404'd on the built bundle. Also updated the SPA-fallback path and log line to `/ts/pbt/harness/`.
- **`ts/pbt/run.mjs`** — spawn path, harness URL, and spec path now `ts/pbt/...`.
- **`ts/pbt/harness/index.html`** — script src → `/ts/pbt/harness/harness.js`.
- **`ts/pbt/tsconfig.json`** — extends `../../tsconfig.json`.
- **`package.json`** — `lint` drops the separate `./pbt` arg (it's under `./ts` now); `test:pbt` runs `node ts/pbt/run.mjs`.
- **`.eslintrc.cjs`** — the pbt override globs and project path updated.
- **`tsconfig.build.json`** — added `ts/pbt/**` to `exclude`. This was the one new hazard the move created: the build config includes `ts/**/*.ts`, so without the exclusion rollup would have pulled `spec.ts` into the frontend bundle's type-check program.
- **`AGENTS.md`** — Bombadil section paths updated. `bombadil.yml` needed no changes (it only calls `yarn test:pbt` and uploads `pbt-output/`).
